notes:
Summary: Lost to hyperscaler managed endpoints (AWS SageMaker Endpoints). Consolidation + enterprise agreement with AWS + desire to minimize vendor footprint were decisive. PoC started but paused and then cancelled.

Key highlights / rep notes:
- 2024-06-12: initial inbound; interested in replacing legacy on-prem chat stack with low-latency hosted inference for support bots.
- 2024-07-22: kickoff call (Fireflies ff_2024-07-22_AltairKickoff) — strong interest in embeddings for search/rerank; latency target 150-200ms p50 for chat, burst throughput 300 req/s.
- 2024-08-05: security questionnaire shared (SOC2 + SSO + KMS required). Security asked for evidence of audit logging and data residency controls.
- 2024-08-28: PoC approved by engineering; SE (Luis) configured a small Dedicated pool for evaluation.
- 2024-09-10: security deep-dive (Fireflies ff_2024-09-10_SecurityReview) — they pressed on integration with existing AWS KMS and CloudTrail.
- 2024-09-20: procurement flagged existing enterprise AWS RA/discount; finance asked for TCO comparison vs AWS SageMaker endpoints.
- 2024-09-27: decision call — internal infra team lead said: "we're standardizing on AWS native services to reduce ops overhead." No internal champion remained to push a best-of-breed vendor decision.
- 2024-10-02: AE follow-up confirmed selection of AWS managed endpoints; Altair will not proceed with Redwood at this time.

Quote from CTO on decision call: "We like Redwood's performance but our procurement mandate is consolidation under AWS — difficult to justify another managed vendor right now."

POC learnings / tech bits:
- Our dedicated pool met latency targets in lab, but integration work required for KMS + CloudTrail added perceived risk for their security team (they prioritized zero additional vendor integrations).
- Pricing delta: Redwood numbers were competitive on a unit basis, but AWS EDP discounts + internal tooling for SageMaker tipped the economic case.

Follow-ups attempted: pricing rework (sent 2024-09-25), proposal v3 (drive link), CISO intro offer (denied). AE to retain contact; recommended check-in at next renewal/when they standardize cloud stance.

loss_reason: Chose hyperscaler managed endpoints (AWS SageMaker Endpoints) due to EDP discounts, consolidation mandate, and lower perceived operational overhead.
